definition: Cruelly violent, uncivilised, or lacking the qualities of a humane society.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: Why, in the English Parliament a Member got up last week and speaking about the Nihilists asked the Ministry whether it was not high time to intervene, to educate this barbarous people.
example_sentence: The prisoners described barbarous conditions in the jail.
